description.value: Pallet Coffee Roasters is a locally owned Vancouver specialty coffee roastery established in East Vancouver in 2014, now operating eight café locations across Metro Vancouver. The Melville Street outpost (branded 'Pallet Melville') is one of several cafés serving expertly roasted single-origin coffees alongside food and freshly baked goods. Beyond its cafés, Pallet runs a full-service roastery, barista training program, and wholesale supply operation across Canada.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (4 spaces) at 27m; stands (5 spaces) at 76m; stands (5 spaces) at 87m. Total: 14 spaces.
